module_summary: Movement controller: FSM with 4 state bits (TRK_W/TRK_E/DROP_W/DROP_E) managing direction based on bumpers and ground.

anchors.name: mv
anchors.why: 4-state movement controller: TRK_W/TRK_E track horizontally; DROP_W/DROP_E drop vertically.

anchors.name: gnd_lost
anchors.why: Inverted ground flag: triggers drop sequence when platform ends.

anchors.name: to_east
anchors.why: Direction decision combining bump sensors and current state.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Output: walk left when in TRK_W or DROP_W state.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Output: walk right when in TRK_E or DROP_E state.

anchors.name: mv_shadow
anchors.why: Rotated copy of mv register for internal observation.

groups.name: State Machine
groups.description: 4-state movement machine: track left/right, drop left/right.

groups.name: Control Logic
groups.description: Ground detection and direction selection combinational logic.

groups.name: Storage
groups.description: Duplicate register for verification or monitoring.
